The students in the class all silently lower their heads. After a while, a girl named Xiao Mei runs into the classroom and says to Teacher Zhao: "I'm sorry, teacher, I am late." Teacher Zhao nods: "Go to your seat." Xiao Mei quietly sits down and starts to write her homework.

[Question]
If there is, which sentence is inappropriate?

B. Go to your seat.
